draft.shortGloss: to watch; to look at; to seem
draft.emotion: attentive and curious, focusing one's eyes on a new detail
notes: More active than มอง (/mɔːŋ/, 'to look towards / gaze at') and เห็น (/hěn/, 'to see').
Placed after another verb, it means 'to try doing something to see what happens', e.g., ลองชิมดู ('try tasting it').
